description: Finds where an IP address is and what network it is on (country, city, ASN and organisation), and whether it is Tor, a VPN or a datacenter. Charged per check from your balance; the sandbox (a pt_test_ key) is free.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address of the end user, e.g. 203.0.113.1.
